content.short: Archly V2 is a cross-chain ve(3,3) DEX with stable and volatile AMM pools plus incentive voting.
content.description: Archly V2 is a decentralized exchange based on the Solidly ve(3,3) design, expanded for cross-chain liquidity and incentive coordination. The protocol supports both stable and volatile pools, custom pool fees, gauges, bribes, emissions voting, and a liquid incentive system intended to help protocols bootstrap useful liquidity instead of temporary farm-and-dump capital. Archly also connects its DEX to Rainbow Road, its cross-chain infrastructure layer, so projects can build liquidity and voting markets across multiple EVM ecosystems including Mantle.
content.meta: Archly V2 is a cross-chain ve(3,3) DEX for swaps, gauges, voting, and liquidity incentives on Mantle.
